tasks.short: Identify new advertising markets and propose suitable advertising products.

steps.what: Review sales, audience, inventory and campaign results for underserved segments.
Read industry news and competitor offers for emerging demand.

loop.input: Approved industry sources, competitor offers and segment baseline.
loop.output: Dated market signals with source links and explicit uncertainties.
loop.check: Require source passages for each factual claim; seller checks relevance and unsupported conclusions.
loop.stop: One summary and one correction pass per batch; inaccessible or conflicting sources enter an exception list.
loop.why_not_simpler: Sources describe demand in varied free text; keyword alerts cannot reliably explain the signal.

steps.what: Discuss unmet needs and buying constraints with prospective advertisers.
Agree a product hypothesis, delivery constraints and commercial assumptions with operations.
Write a product proposal with audience, pricing assumptions and a pilot plan.

loop.input: Product hypothesis, delivery constraints, approved rate card and segment baseline.
loop.output: Product proposal separating observed facts, assumptions and pilot measures.
loop.check: Code verifies calculations and required sections; seller checks positioning, evidence and feasibility.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; missing commercial assumptions return to the seller.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template handles structure and calculations, but the market-specific rationale needs contextual writing.

steps.what: Approve, revise or reject the proposed pilot and its spending limits.

tasks.design: A scheduled job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} combines permitted {CRM}, {ADS} and {BI} data into a segment dashboard. Bounded reading and drafting loops produce sourced market signals and a proposal in {DOCS}, with calculations checked by code. Customer discovery, product choices and pilot approval remain human decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sales, audience and inventory data have different definitions; research and proposal writing require repeated manual assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding can reduce the effort of building connectors and proposal tools. Bounded models can summarise varied sources without controlling commercial decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Audience data rights, cross-channel comparability and proof of willingness to pay remain difficult. A convincing proposal cannot establish demand.
tasks.human_edge: The seller hears hesitation, tests willingness to pay and negotiates a product that operations can deliver.
tasks.altitude: The seller spends less time assembling evidence and more time testing market hypotheses. They can recommend pilot selection from current evidence; spending authority stays with the sales manager.

reach.task: Assess a proposed market pilot against margin and capacity.
reach.learn: Contribution margin, pilot design and explicit stop criteria.

evidence.claim: Lead research and fit assessment exist in current sales software; this does not establish automated market-product discovery.
Joined dashboards, rule-checked calculations and bounded proposal drafting are feasible implementation patterns.

assumptions: The employer sells advertising inventory or packages and has access to relevant sales and audience data.
Step shares are estimates for a typical mid-size European employer, not measured customer timings.
The seller's personal starter can accept approved exports; shared deployment requires employer access.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply. The access range includes data permissions and employee consultation under national rules where required.
unknowns: Which audience and competitor sources may be reused?
Can inventory and campaign results be joined to sales records?
Who can authorise a pilot, and what spending limits apply?
Which national consultation requirements apply to the proposed deployment?
research_questions: Which market signals predict qualified advertiser interest rather than general industry attention?
What minimum evidence makes a pilot decision useful?
new_work: Review source accuracy and separate evidence from assumptions.
Maintain segment mappings and connector permissions.
Track pilot outcomes and retire weak market signals.

tasks.short: Write advertising copy that fits the layout and the advertiser's brief.

steps.what: Confirm the audience, offer, tone and required wording with the advertiser.
Retrieve approved claims, brand guidance and previous advertising copy.
Draft headlines, body copy and calls to action.

loop.input: Advertising brief, approved claims, brand guidance and layout limits.
loop.output: A small set of copy variants with claim references.
loop.check: Code checks required wording and length; seller checks meaning, tone and claim support.
loop.stop: At most three variants and one revision; unresolved claims return to the advertiser.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates suit repeated offers, but varied briefs require contextual wording and creative choices.

steps.what: Fit copy into the layout and inspect readability and visual balance.
Obtain the advertiser's approval of the final proof.

tasks.design: A brief form in {WORKFLOW} retrieves approved material from {DOCS} and {CRM}; a bounded drafting loop produces copy variants. A template renderer in {OTHER} checks layout limits and produces a proof for visual review. An approval flow records the advertiser's decision against the exact proof version before production.
tasks.previous_blocker: Copy varies by advertiser, and layout constraints are often separated from the brief and approved claims.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can work from approved sources, while code handles length, required wording, template placement and version tracking.
tasks.still_hard: Distinctive creative work, multilingual nuance and unusual layouts still need skilled editing. Claim support can be incomplete or disputed.
tasks.human_edge: The seller and designer judge persuasion, cultural meaning and visual emphasis, and resolve competing advertiser preferences.

ambition.what: A copy-and-proof starter package for small advertisers without creative staff.

tasks.altitude: The seller reviews variants and resolves the brief instead of starting every draft from scratch. They can offer a defined starter package within approved templates; publication approval remains with the advertiser.

reach.task: Scope and price a repeatable creative support package.
reach.learn: Service boundaries, revision allowances and delivery costing.

evidence.claim: Approved-source drafting, template rendering and version-specific approval can support advertising copy production.
The digest provides no documented advertising-copy case establishing the expected time saving.

assumptions: The layout editor is a design application represented by {OTHER}.
Standard advertising formats cover enough work to justify reusable templates.
The advertiser supplies approved claims and authorises use of brand material.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply; data access and consultation under national rules, where required, are included in the access range.
The future time estimates allow substantial creative review despite the task's potential for draft automation.
unknowns: Which layout formats support automated text placement and proof export?
Who approves claims and final advertising proofs?
Which languages and regulated advertising categories are common?
Can existing brand material be processed by the proposed drafting service?
research_questions: Which formats work reliably with template-based rendering?
How often do generated variants require a complete rewrite?
new_work: Check generated copy against claim sources and advertiser intent.
Maintain templates, brand guidance and required wording.
Handle proof revisions and preserve version-specific approvals.

tasks.short: Attend sales meetings, trade shows and seminars to learn, promote advertising and develop relationships.

steps.what: Choose relevant events and set learning and relationship objectives.
Enter session times, locations and preparation reminders.
Attend sessions, ask questions and discuss practical lessons.
Meet contacts, explore advertiser needs and present relevant advertising options.
Record contacts, commitments and useful lessons after attendance.

loop.input: Seller-authored contact notes, explicit commitments and learning notes.
loop.output: Proposed contact updates, dated tasks and a short learning summary.
loop.check: Match existing contacts, flag uncertain identities and require seller approval before saving.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass; ambiguous contacts stay unfiled.
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-form notes contain varied names, commitments and dates that fixed field mappings cannot consistently extract.

steps.what: Send agreed material or propose a next conversation.

tasks.design: Configure {CALENDAR} reminders and a short capture form connected to {CRM} and {DOCS}. A bounded extraction loop turns seller-authored notes into proposed records and tasks, saved after review. Approved templates prepare follow-up messages in {EMAIL}; the seller chooses recipients and sends them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Most value comes from attendance and relationships. Useful follow-up details are scattered across personal notes and contact records.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scheduling features cover preparation, while bounded extraction reduces the effort of filing informal notes.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, spontaneous introductions and learning through discussion remain personal. Notes may omit the context that makes a commitment meaningful.
tasks.human_edge: The seller earns introductions, notices interest and discomfort, and adapts the conversation without damaging trust.
tasks.altitude: Attendance and relationship work still dominate the week. The seller gains preparation and follow-up time; decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Evaluate an event's contribution to qualified opportunities and useful learning.
reach.learn: Attribution limits, opportunity quality and realistic follow-up windows.

evidence.claim: Scheduling, contact deduplication, note extraction and template follow-up can reduce event administration.
The supplied digest does not establish that automation can replace professional networking or attendance.

assumptions: The task covers attendance and follow-up; travel purchasing and expense reimbursement are separate.
Scheduling uses structured event details or a seller-selected programme.
The solution processes seller-authored notes without recording conversations or scoring employees.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply; contact processing and outreach must follow applicable national rules.
The access range includes permissions and any required employee consultation.
unknowns: Which contact fields and retention rules are authorised?
What outreach permissions and restrictions apply to collected contacts?
Which events are virtual, internal or attended in person?
research_questions: Which capture fields preserve commitments without making note-taking burdensome?
Does faster follow-up improve qualified conversations after events?
new_work: Review contact matches and extracted commitments.
Maintain follow-up templates and contact retention rules.
Resolve duplicates and close stale follow-up tasks.

tasks.short: Write sales outlines that help staff explain advertising offers and handle common objections.

steps.what: Gather current product facts, audience evidence, prices and sales policies.
Review recent sales feedback for questions and recurring objections.

loop.input: Permitted sales feedback and selected customer correspondence.
loop.output: Objection themes linked to source examples, with customer details minimised.
loop.check: Validate source references and counts; seller checks grouping and removes misleading examples.
loop.stop: One classification pass and one correction; uncertain items remain unclassified.
loop.why_not_simpler: Customers express the same concern in varied language; fixed keywords miss or merge important distinctions.

steps.what: Write a sales outline with discovery questions, benefits, evidence and objection responses.

loop.input: Approved source pack, objection themes and an outline template.
loop.output: A sourced sales outline with questions, benefit statements and permitted responses.
loop.check: Verify prices against the rate card and claims against sources; seller checks usefulness and tone.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims are omitted and flagged.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide structure, but adapting explanations and responses to a sales context needs contextual writing.

steps.what: Review commercial accuracy and approve the outline for staff use.
Publish the approved outline and notify staff of the current version.

tasks.design: A job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} assembles approved facts from {DOCS} and {CRM}; bounded loops classify objections and draft a sales outline. Deterministic checks validate prices, source references and required sections. After sales manager approval, {WORKFLOW} publishes the exact approved version in {DOCS} and sends an internal notice through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facts and feedback are dispersed, and every update requires manual gathering, rewriting and distribution.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned source retrieval and workflow configuration handle assembly and release. Bounded models can turn varied feedback into a reviewable outline.
tasks.still_hard: A polished outline may teach weak selling habits or overstate evidence. Selecting useful questions and credible responses still requires sales experience.
tasks.human_edge: Experienced sellers know which questions reveal a real buying problem and which responses sound evasive or overpromising.

ambition.what: Weekly selection of the objection response to test in sales coaching.

tasks.altitude: The seller spends less time compiling documents and more time testing their usefulness with colleagues. They can recommend coaching experiments; the sales manager retains approval of official guidance.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of non-retail sales workers
reach.task: Coach staff using a selected discovery question or objection response.
reach.learn: Role-play facilitation, feedback quality and evaluating observed sales behaviour.

evidence.claim: Source-based drafting, rule checks and approval-triggered publication can support sales outline production.
The supplied digest contains no documented sales-outline case supporting a measured productivity claim.

assumptions: Approved product facts, rate cards and policies have identifiable current versions.
Feedback is analysed to improve guidance, without recording calls or scoring individual employees.
The high automation prior applies mainly to assembly and drafting; commercial approval remains a distinct decision.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply. Permissions and any consultation required by national rules are included in the access range.
A personal starter can work from approved source files before shared integrations are available.
unknowns: Which feedback and correspondence may be reused?
How are obsolete prices and claims withdrawn?
Which national employee consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Which outline sections do staff actually use during preparation?
How should coaching tests distinguish useful guidance from changes in lead quality?
new_work: Review objection groupings and unsupported claims.
Maintain source ownership, expiry dates and outline templates.
Withdraw outdated versions and collect staff feedback.
Evaluate coaching experiments before changing official guidance.

role.altitude: The advertising sales agent spends less time assembling research, drafting routine material and filing notes. More time goes to customer discovery, creative decisions and testing offers; budget, publication and official-guidance approvals remain with their designated approvers.
reach: Sales manager: assess market pilots using margin, capacity and customer evidence.
Sales representative of services: define a priced creative support package.
First-line supervisor of non-retail sales workers: test and coach practical sales guidance.
skills_to_grow: Data permissions, workflow exceptions and practical coaching.
role.ambitious_version: Become an advertising growth adviser who tests underserved segments, offers small advertisers a defined creative starter service and turns customer objections into better sales coaching.
